title: when creating a new channel, should just show 'coordinator', not name it after the channel. also, when I go into aura I…

items.content: Name channel coordinators 'coordinator' (new + migrate existing '#slug coordinator')
AGENTS tab: channel coordinators count as instances of the coordinator definition
Review both changes and run fmt/clippy/tests

summary: I've made both changes. A new channel's coordinator is now named just `coordinator`, and coordinators now show up as instances of the coordinator agent in the AGENTS tab. Neither change is committed yet. I haven't run it in the real app.
